name: discover/open-in-app
title: OpenInApp
summary: The "Open in Mukoko" action: an https link to the item in the Mukoko super-app, by default the canonical universal link `https://mukoko.com/open/<service>/<id>`, with one line saying what happens. Never a bare custom scheme.

props.name: service
props.description: The Mukoko service the item lives in (`MukokoService`). With `id`, the link is `openInMukokoUrl(service, id)`.

props.name: id
props.description: The item's id in that service; percent-encoded into one path segment.

props.name: href
props.description: An explicit https URL that opens the app where it is installed and the web otherwise. Overrides `service` and `id` when given (kept for links that are not one item, and for server-filled shells). One of `href`, or `service` with `id`, is required.

props.name: hint
props.default: Opens in the Mukoko app, or on the web if you don't have it.

props.name: variant
props.description: Primary on an item's own page; outline beside another primary action.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Other actions, beside the button and above the hint (e.g. "Start your own circle").

behaviour: One link styled as a button, then the hint.

With `service` and `id` the href is the canonical universal link `https://mukoko.com/open/<service>/<id>` (`openInMukokoUrl`, `discover-open-link.ts`; `MUKOKO_OPEN_ORIGIN` is `https://mukoko.com`). The Mukoko apps claim `mukoko.com/open/*` (universal links, app links), so it opens the item in the app where it is installed. Elsewhere the resolver in mukoko-dev/super-app-web (`/open/*`) redirects a desktop browser or a crawler to the item's public page (the web app for an item with none), and gives a phone a choice page: "Open in the Mukoko app" (the store listing) or "Continue on the web".

An explicit `href` wins over `service` and `id`. With neither `href` nor both of `service` and `id`, rendering fails; an unknown service or an empty id fails too (a RangeError), so a broken link is a build error, not a 404.
The link is https: a `mukoko://` link does nothing for someone without the app, so it is never the href.
Other actions (the default slot) sit in the button's row; the hint is under the whole row.

actions.description: A second action beside the button.

canonical.description: An item by service and id: the canonical universal link.

encoded.description: An id that is not URL-safe is encoded into one path segment.

aria: The label says the action; the hint is plain text after it.

theming.brandOverlay: The primary variant fills with `--primary`, so it is the brand's mineral.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: The hint wraps under the button.
contract:
contract
  slot is "open-in-app"
  a "Join in Mukoko" min_height 48
  a "Open in Mukoko" min_height 48
  when default shows p "Opens in the Mukoko app, or on the web if you don't have it."
  when outline shows a "Open in Mukoko"
  when actions shows a "Start your own circle"
  when canonical shows a "Open in Mukoko"
end

checks.say: An empty hint is left out.
The second action shares the button's row.
service and id make the canonical universal link.
The id is one encoded path segment.
